notes: Game lasts 6 rounds. Official rulebook (BGG files 301687, Scribd mirror, publisher pages) re-attempted and still not readable (403 / no text); values come from a single detailed how-to-play article, so verify against the rulebook. Unclear whether roughed-out (unfinished) instruments on the workbench count for the half-points rule or only those on the finishing board. 4-player first-chair table: sources disagree on whether 3 chairs scores 1 (<=3 vs exactly 3); modelled as 3 -> 1. Built instruments always hold first chair; otherwise majority of repair/performance tokens decides (done before counting chairs). Awards/real-time points belong in the prestige track. Possible second-edition / Deluxe differences not checked. family: auction-money.
